admission.justification: An allowlist or lexical string masquerading as an exception hides newly introduced speed and state dependencies.

applicability: Python and dashboard source scans over the registered test and mutable-state populations.
conditions: A permitted exception is a real line/preceding-line comment with a nonempty reason.
Python AST and TypeScript-literal masking check the packet-defined syntactic classes, including multiline clocks and exponential numeric bounds.
exclusions: Computed or variable bounds, object/closure/library state and semantic truth of marker reasons are outside the syntactic scan.
No baseline or allowlist absorbs new violations.

evidence: Python20pattern/state/condition checks; dashboard20pattern/marker checks including string-marker spoof

statement: The source scanners reject the stated syntactic timing/state classes and require real comment markers with reasons.
